issue_context.title: Native parquet reader coerces null string values to empty strings
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

Reproduce with this issue:

```python
import polars as pl
import pandas as pd

print(pl.__version__)
print(pd.__version__)

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [None]})
string_cast = df["a"].astype(pd.StringDtype())
df = string_cast.to_frame()
print(df)

df.to_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet")

df = pl.read_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet", use_pyarrow=False)

print("Reading parquet with native engine:")
print(df["a"])

df2 = pl.read_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet", use_pyarrow=True)

print("Reading parquet with pyarrow engine:")
print(df2["a"])
```

Result:
```bash
0.20.10
1.5.1
      a
0  <NA>
Reading parquet with native engine:
shape: (1,)
Series: 'a' [str]
[
        ""
]
Reading parquet with pyarrow engine:
shape: (1,)
Series: 'a' [str]
[
        null
]
```

The native parquet reader behaves correctly when the input column is mixed with `NULL` and strings:

```python
import polars as pl
import pandas as pd

print(pl.__version__)
print(pd.__version__)

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": ["test", None]})
string_cast = df["a"].astype(pd.StringDtype())
df = string_cast.to_frame()
print(df)

df.to_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet")

df = pl.read_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet", use_pyarrow=False)

print("Reading parquet with native engine:")
print(df["a"])

df2 = pl.read_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet", use_pyarrow=True)

print("Reading parquet with pyarrow engine:")
print(df2["a"])
```

Result (correct):

```bash
0.20.10
1.5.1
      a
0  test
1  <NA>
Reading parquet with native engine:
shape: (2,)
Series: 'a' [str]
[
        "test"
        null
]
Reading parquet with pyarrow engine:
shape: (2,)
Series: 'a' [str]
[
        "test"
        null
]
```

### Log output

```shell
No additional log output
```


### Issue description

The native parquet reader should not coerce `NULL` values to empty strings. 

### Expected behavior


```python
import polars as pl
import pandas as pd

print(pl.__version__)
print(pd.__version__)

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [None]})
string_cast = df["a"].astype(pd.StringDtype())
df = string_cast.to_frame()
print(df)

df.to_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet")

df = pl.read_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet", use_pyarrow=False)

print("Reading parquet with native engine:")
print(df["a"])

df2 = pl.read_parquet("~/temp/temp.parquet", use_pyarrow=True)

print("Reading parquet with pyarrow engine:")
print(df2["a"])
```

Result:
```bash
0.20.10
1.5.1
      a
0  <NA>
Reading parquet with native engine:
shape: (1,)
Series: 'a' [str]
[
        null
]
Reading parquet with pyarrow engine:
shape: (1,)
Series: 'a' [str]
[
        null
]
```

### Installed versions

<details>

```
--------Version info---------
Polars:               0.20.10
Index type:           UInt32
Platform:             macOS-13.5-arm64-arm-64bit
Python:               3.9.6 (default, Aug 11 2023, 19:44:49) 
[Clang 15.0.0 (clang-1500.0.40.1)]

----Optional dependencies----
adbc_driver_manager:  <not installed>
cloudpickle:          <not installed>
connectorx:           <not installed>
deltalake:            0.10.2
fsspec:               2023.12.2
gevent:               <not installed>
hvplot:               <not installed>
matplotlib:           3.5.3
numpy:                1.22.4
openpyxl:             3.0.10
pandas:               1.5.1
pyarrow:              8.0.0
pydantic:             1.10.0
pyiceberg:            <not installed>
pyxlsb:               <not installed>

xlsx2csv:             <not installed>
xlsxwriter:           <not installed>
```

</details>

review_comments: This branch is under `FilteredHybridEncoded::Repeated`, and it is hit either when the column is all NULL, or if there's a sequence of something like 1.5 million+ rows of NULLs in case there were non-NULL rows before/after (e.g. with only 1 million NULLs it doesn't trigger). (when writing a parquet with pyarrow)

This was correct for numerics because for `T: NativeType`, `Pushable` is implemented for `Option<T>`, so `T::default()` is `None`:

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/849953b097e0d15fe107f3683f003228103b425d/crates/polars-arrow/src/pushable.rs#L96

But for binary / string types `Pushable` is implemented directly for `T`, so `T::default()` gives the empty string instead of NULL:

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/849953b097e0d15fe107f3683f003228103b425d/crates/polars-arrow/src/pushable.rs#L123

I suspect there is some non-trivial inconsistency/duplication in how `Option<T>` is being handled, so the easiest fix is to just add an `extend_null_constant` method. This is reasonable to me since there is already a `push_null` method alongside the `push` method on the trait.
Yeah, I am not convinced `T::default()` always is `None` indeed.
